group built its om temple. Malwa ‘purchased a house

主题：锡克国民协会年度选举
锡克国民协会于1942年12月26日下午2时在宝兴路330号举行会议。该协会主席切特·辛格（Chet Singh）向会员通报了协会取得的进展，并感谢会员出席会议。协会秘书比尚·辛格（Bishan Singh）宣读了关于进行年度选举的规章制度。
协会每位会员持有一张选票。提名了三十四人，但只有得票数较多的二十四人当选。这二十四名当选者将选举产生协会职员。投票结果预计将在几天后公布。约有70人出席。被提名人中没有警务人员。会议于下午4时结束。

SUBJECT: Re: Sikh National Society.

Sikh National Society was established on 25th July
1942. Though it was announced that this society was a
religious one, but actually it was a British agency to
carry on the evil policy of "Divide and Rule". Its
promoters were all British agents and M. Chet Singh
Granthi was elected as their President. So they had
aimed, that they will penetrate into the Political body
through it. In the meantime it became prosperous as
among Indians the Sikhs have majority in Shanghai. As
there were four different societies of Indians in Shang-
hai, the Japanese authorities made Indian Independence
League dissolving all four. Mr. Hongo and Niwa invited
two members from each society. Dr. Daya Ram Mehtani was
elected president by voting among those 8 members. But
owing to the Sikh majority and some other reasons Mr.
Hongo forced to all to accept M. Chet Singh as their
president. It was done so and executive committee of 8
members was formed to direct the work of Indian Independen-
ce League. The Sikhs did not dissolve their society.
The executive members of the Sikh National Society
had declared to the public that this society will hear
all the complaints by Sikhs and all their difficulties
would be disposed without delay. All this was a false
show to bluff the innocent masses and to keep them in
dark. The policy of this society was either to put an
obstruction before the League work or to penetrate in
it so that its leaders may reach their destination in or-
to carry on the British policy "Divide & Rule" to make

主题：关于：锡克国民协会。

锡克国民协会成立于1942年7月25日。虽然宣称该协会为宗教团体，但实际上它是英国推行“分而治之”恶政的工具。其发起者均为英国代理人，M. 切特·辛格·格兰蒂（Granthi）被选为主席。因此他们的目标是借此渗透进政治机构。与此同时，由于在上海的印度人中西克教徒占多数，该协会得以繁荣发展。由于上海有四个不同的印度人团体，日本当局解散了所有这四个团体，成立了印度独立联盟。本乡（Hongo）先生和丹羽（Niwa）先生邀请每个团体派出两名代表。在这8名成员中，通过投票选举达亚·拉姆·梅塔尼（Daya Ram Mehtani）博士为主席。但由于锡克教徒占多数及其他原因，本乡先生迫使所有人接受 M. 切特·辛格为主席。此事就此办妥，并成立了由8名成员组成的执行委员会来指导印度独立联盟的工作。锡克教徒并未解散其协会。
锡克国民协会的执行委员向公众宣称，该协会将受理锡克教徒的所有投诉，并立即处理他们的所有困难。这一切都是为了欺骗无辜民众、使其蒙在鼓里的虚假表演。该协会的政策要么是阻碍联盟的工作，要么渗透其中，以便其领导人达到目的，从而继续推行英国的“分而治之”政策，以使

SUBJECT: Sikh National Society

Sikh National Society was established on 24-7-
42. Prior to the formation of the said society, there
were two groups of Sikhs Majah and Malwa. These two
groups were functioning together in Sikh Temple, 330
Paoshing Road. There have been serious clashes between
Majah and Malwa in 1936 which resulted the deportation
of several Sikhs from Shanghai and a few were sentenced
to various terms of imprisonment by the British Court.
The cause of the whole trouble was to gain domination in
the management of the Sikh Temple, 330 Paoshing Road.
In order to avoid the further trouble each
group built its own temple. Malwa purchased a house
162 Mohawk Road and Majah bought a house on Chusan Road
and carried on their religious work in temples.
In last year, having realised the difficulties
of the future some of the wise Sikhs advised them to
form one body. Sikhs were desirous to remove the fric-
tion between Majah and Malwa, therefore all agreed to
join into one body.
The Sikh National Society was formed on 24-7-42
and the friction between two groups which was existing
for a long time removed by the formation of Sikh Society.
The object of the Society was to unite the all Sikhs and
to wrok for the welfare of Sikhs and give possible
sacrifice for the freedom of India.
In last year 1942, there were several asso-
ciations but according to the instruction received from
Mr. Ras Bihari Bose all the existing associations had
to be dissolved. The heads of respective associations

主题：锡克国民协会

锡克国民协会成立于1942年7月24日。在该协会成立之前，锡克教徒分为马贾（Majah）和马尔瓦（Malwa）两个派系。这两个派系曾在宝兴路330号的锡克庙共同活动。1936年，马贾和马尔瓦之间发生过严重冲突，导致几名锡克教徒被驱逐出上海，另有几人被英国法庭判处不同期限的监禁。整个纠纷的起因是为了争夺宝兴路330号锡克庙的管理权。
为了避免进一步的麻烦，每个派系建立了自己的庙宇。马尔瓦派购买了莫霍克路162号的一处房屋，马贾派购买了中山路（Chusan Road）的一处房屋，并在各自的庙宇中进行宗教活动。
去年，鉴于未来的困难，一些明智的锡克教徒建议他们组成一个统一的团体。锡克教徒希望消除马贾和马尔瓦之间的摩擦，因此所有人都同意合并为一个团体。
锡克国民协会于1942年7月24日成立，通过成立锡克协会，消除了两个派系之间长期存在的摩擦。协会的宗旨是团结所有锡克教徒，为锡克教徒的福利工作，并为印度的自由做出可能的牺牲。
在去年的1942年，有几个协会，但根据从拉什·比哈里·鲍斯（Ras Bihari Bose）先生那里收到的指示，所有现有协会必须解散。各协会的负责人

SUBJECT: Further to Sikh National Society

Sikh National Society consist only sikhs.
It is formed to unite all local sikhs and to remove the friction between Majah and Malwa and to safeguard the interests of sikhs in Shanghai.

In India, sikhs living south of river Satluj are called Malwa and north of Satluj called Majah.
In Shanghai, the area south of Soochow Creek is called Malwa and north of Soochow Creek called Majah. Sikh police is divided into Majah and Malwa. The ratio of promotion is fifty and fifty.

Though there are many religions in India but from political military and economical point of view, there are three major religions, Hindu, Mohammadans and Sikhs. Sikhs are about 1/50 of whole Indian population but they are 1/3 in Indian army.

Indian army consist of Sikhs, Mohammadans and some Hindu. Sikhs are brave soldiers and they are always in front line to give sacrifices for their mother land. The man who killed general O. Dyer in London was a Sikh. Although Sikhs are very small in the population of India but they are famous throughout India for giving sacrifices for India.

In Shanghai there were five parties and the members of all parties were almost Sikhs but the heads of the parties were Hindu or Mohammadans and they did not care for the interests fo Sikhs. For an instance, every head of the party wanted to be the president of I.I.L. with the help of Sikhs. Sikhs realized their mistake and they gained unity by forming Sikh National Society and also obtained the presidency of the I.I.L.

（批：10 3 43）

报告

外事科，
中央巡捕房及特别分部。档案号。日期：1943年3月9日。

主题：关于锡克民族协会之续报

锡克民族协会仅由锡克人组成。
其成立旨在团结当地所有锡克人，消除马贾（Majah）与马尔瓦（Malwa）之间的摩擦，并维护在上海的锡克人的利益。

在印度，居住在萨特莱杰河（Satluj）以南的锡克人被称为马尔瓦人，居住在萨特莱杰河以北的被称为马贾人。
在上海，苏州河以南地区被称为马尔瓦，苏州河以北地区被称为马贾。锡克籍警员分为马贾和马尔瓦两派。晋升比例为五五开。

尽管印度有许多宗教，但从政治、军事和经济角度来看，主要有三大宗教：印度教、穆斯林和锡克教。锡克人约占印度总人口的1/50，但在印度军队中占1/3。

印度军队由锡克人、穆斯林和部分印度教徒组成。锡克人是勇敢的士兵，他们总是冲锋在前，为祖国做出牺牲。在伦敦刺杀奥·戴尔（O. Dyer）将军的人是一名锡克人。虽然锡克人在印度人口中占比很小，但他们因对印度的牺牲精神而闻名全印。

在上海曾有五个党派，各党成员几乎均为锡克人，但党派首领却是印度教徒或穆斯林，他们并不关心锡克人的利益。例如，每个党派首领都想在锡克人的帮助下成为印度独立联盟（I.I.L.）的主席。锡克人意识到了他们的错误，通过成立锡克民族协会实现了团结，并获得了印度独立联盟的主席职位。

（批注：10 3 43）

SUBJECT:
of Shanghai.
The Indians of other religions wish to
dissolve the Sikh Society because they do not want to
see the unity of Sikhs. Indians of other religions are
very jealous of Sikh Society. They only wish the Sikhs
to be their tools.
I believe the Sikh National Society will
never do anything against I.I.L. but spare no efforts
to render all available help for the national cause.
In the national meeting only Sikhs turn out in full
capacity.
I have attended almost all the Indian meetings
held in Shanghai since the declaration of the Pacific
War. I have never seen Hindu and Mohammadans in any
meeting in large numbers except few men. If Indians
be called to go in front line, then you will see how
many Sikhs and others will join the national army. I
am sure, first of all, Sikhs would go forward. Indians
procession will march on Nanking Road on 11-3-43 and
there you may judge the national spirit of Sikhs and
other Indians.
Maghar Singh

主题：
上海的。
其他宗教的印度人希望
解散锡克协会，因为他们不愿
看到锡克人的团结。其他宗教的印度人
对锡克协会非常嫉妒。他们只希望锡克人
成为他们的工具。
我相信锡克民族协会绝不会
做任何不利于印度独立联盟（I.I.L.）的事，而是会不遗余力地
为民族事业提供一切可能的帮助。
在民族会议上，只有锡克人全员出席。
自太平洋战争爆发以来，我参加了几乎所有
在上海举行的印度人会议。除了少数几人外，
我从未在任何会议上见过大量印度教徒和穆斯林。
如果号召印度人上前线，那么你就会看到有多少
锡克人和其他人会加入国民军。我敢肯定，
锡克人会首先挺身而出。印度人游行队伍将于
1943年3月11日在南京路行进，届时你可以评判
锡克人和其他印度人的民族精神。
马加尔·辛格（Maghar Singh）

SUBJECT: Re Sikh Society.

At 4 p.m. 18-12-43 the Sikh Society held
its emergency meeting in 330 Paoshing Road.
Mr. Chet Singh president explained the
object of the meeting and requested the members
that hereafter there will be only one organization
that is the I.I. League. Therefore we dissolve
the Sikh Society from to-day, 18-12-43.
Almost all members were present and the
meeting came to and end at 5.20 p.m.

主题：关于锡克协会。

1943年12月18日下午4时，锡克协会在保兴路330号召开紧急会议。

几乎所有会员均出席，会议于下午5时20分结束。

SUBJECT: The birthday celebration of Sri Guru Gobind.

On 2-1-44, the local Sikh community celebrated the

主题：斯里·古鲁·戈宾德·辛格吉（Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji）诞辰庆典。

1944年1月2日，本地锡克社区在所有锡克寺庙举行了斯里·古鲁·戈宾德·辛格吉的诞辰仪式，从清晨持续至凌晨4时。下午，所有锡克寺庙均举行了会议。祈祷内容涉及团结、好运和自由。

在花园路警察锡克寺庙举行的下午会议上，以下人员朗诵了有关斯里·古鲁·戈宾德·辛格吉生平的诗歌：

阿夫塔尔·辛格（Avtar Singh）
普里塔姆·考尔（Pritam Kaur）
曼吉特·考尔（Manjit Kaur）
迪亚尔·辛格（Dial Singh）
首席格兰西（Head Granthi）拉奇·辛格（Lachh Singh）。

特拉普塔尔·辛格（Traptar Singh）。S.S.C
